spec._comment: FINALIST GRID — regime L + GOOD-PLAYER proxy. Same live-parity chain frequency as spec-live.json, but the AI also plays a thinned, chain-drafted deck with more cards seen and paid for per strike (DECK_THIN/HAND_BONUS/EMBER_REFILL). Paired with spec-live.json this gives a within-sim bad-player vs good-player pair, which is the Balatro skill-gap metric.
